verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Anytype lets you share spaces and collaborate with chosen people: you control and grant access to your spaces, collaborators need no email or subscription, and collaboration works over peer-to-peer sync or a self-hosted network. The 2023 community remarks that sharing was not yet available read as dated status, not a concrete failure of the current feature. Nothing describes simultaneous co-editing or how concurrent changes are merged without conflict. Missing for 10: documented real-time co-editing of the same note, a conflict-resolution or merge mechanism, permission-role details, and independent hands-on confirmation that collaboration works.
